settings.heading: Features
settings.content:
It has a bronze shade without a red or golden undertone, which allows you to get exactly the effect of a natural tan.

Thanks to the rich pigment, the color is bright and saturated throughout the day. And due to the method and amount of application, you can adjust the saturation of the tanning effect.

  • Quickly and evenly applied
  • Easy to spread
  • Does not crumble
  • Does not crack
  • Does not fade during the day

settings.heading: How to guide
settings.content:
1. Before applying the product, it is better to scrub the skin in the evening and moisturize it so that it does not look dry and the product is applied evenly.
  2. Apply bronzer only to dry skin to avoid unnecessary stains or stains.
  3. Shake the bottle of bronzer well before use.
  4. If you apply the bronzer on top of a dark foundation, apply the foundation first, and then the bronzer after 15-20 minutes.
  5. To apply the bronzer, just pour a sufficient amount of bronzer into the palm of your hand or on your body and immediately distribute it over the entire skin area with wide, dragging movements (not strokes). If you want to get a more intense effect, wait until the first layer dries and then apply the second layer in the same way.

settings.heading: Can be used for
settings.content:
• Those who are just starting to get acquainted with makeup products on the floor.
  • Representatives of younger age groups (juveniles, juniors).
  • Those who want a light tanning effect with a delicate shine on the body.

settings.heading: Bottle
settings.content:
• The bottle has a volume of 120 ml.
  • The package has two caps - for the dispenser and for the entire bottle.
  • The dispenser allows you to use the product as efficiently as possible without unnecessary spillage on the floor.
